license_required.quote: A license is required for an individual to engage in the practice of public accounting, except as specifically provided in Section 58-26a-305 or 58-1-307.
license_required.citation: Section 301 - Licensure or registration required -- License and registration classifications.

issuing_authority.value: Division (Utah Division of Occupational and Professional Licensing)
issuing_authority.quote: The division shall issue to an individual who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of Certified Public Accountant.
issuing_authority.citation: Section 301 - Licensure or registration required -- License and registration classifications.

degree_required.value: 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours with a baccalaureate degree
degree_required.quote: successful completion of a total of 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours of collegiate level education with a concentration in accounting, auditing, and business
degree_required.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

accrediting_body.value: accredited institution acceptable to the board
accrediting_body.quote: submit a certified transcript of credits from an accredited institution acceptable to the board
accrediting_body.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

required.quote: submit evidence of one year of accounting experience in a form prescribed by the division
required.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

duration.quote: "Year of experience" means 2,000 hours of experience

kind.value: accounting experience under supervision of a licensed CPA
kind.quote: "Accounting experience" means applying accounting and auditing skills and principles that are taught as a part of the professional education qualifying a person for licensure under this chapter and generally accepted by the profession, under the supervision of a licensed certified public accountant.

exams.name: AICPA Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Must sit for and meet conditioning requirements as established by the AICPA; minimum 120 semester hours required to sit
exams.quote: A person must sit for and meet the conditioning requirements of the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination as established by the AICPA.

exams.name: AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs
exams.quote: "Qualifying examinations" means: (a) the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination; (b) the AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs; (c) the Utah Laws and Rules Examination

exams.name: Utah Laws and Rules Examination
exams.quote: "Qualifying examinations" means: (a) the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination; (b) the AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs; (c) the Utah Laws and Rules Examination

interval_years.quote: The division shall issue each license and registration under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.
interval_years.citation: Section 303 - Term of license and registration -- Expiration -- Renewal.

required.quote: as a condition precedent for a license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education

hours_per_period.quote: complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule

period_years.quote: during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education

value: at least 1 hour covering Utah CPA chapter and Utah Administrative Code R156-26a
at least 3 hours of ethics education (AICPA Code of Professional Conduct, case-based instruction, ethical dilemmas, or business ethics)
topical_requirements.quote: completing at least one hour of continuing professional education that covers: (i) this chapter; and (ii) Utah Administrative Code, R156-26a, Utah Certified Public Accountant Licensing Act Rule; and (e) completing at least three hours of ethics education

available.quote: The division may issue a license under this chapter to a person who holds a license as a certified public accountant issued by any other state of the United States of America
available.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

requirements.value: Applicant must show evidence of passing qualifying examinations and either meet Utah licensure requirements applicable at time of original licensure, have four years of professional experience within the prior 10 years, or show substantial equivalency of education, examination, and experience.
requirements.quote: shows evidence that the applicant's education, examination record, and experience are substantially equivalent to the requirements of Subsection (1), as provided by rule.
requirements.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

regulatory_model.quote: A license is required for an individual to engage in the practice of public accounting, except as specifically provided in Section 58-26a-305 or 58-1-307.
regulatory_model.citation: Section 301 - Licensure or registration required -- License and registration classifications.

title_protection.quote: using "certified public accountant," "public accountant," "CPA," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless that person: (a) has a current license as a certified public accountant issued under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: except as provided in Section 58-26a-305, engaging in the following conduct if not licensed under this chapter to practice public accountancy: (a) issuing a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking an engagement when the licensee knows or should know they cannot complete it with professional competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: undertaking an engagement when the licensee knows or should know that the licensee could not reasonably expect to complete it with professional competence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in the practice of public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business or activity creating a conflict of interest without full written disclosure to all affected parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in any business or activity that creates a conflict of interest with a licensee's practice in the profession when the licensee knows or should know that it is a conflict of interest and the licensee does not fully disclose the conflict of interest in writing to all affected parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet the requirements for continuing professional education or peer review
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to meet the requirements for continuing professional education or peer review required under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing a report on financial statements or performing an attest engagement when not independent in fact and appearance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a client, other than a report in which a lack of independence is disclosed, or performing an attest engagement subject to the attestation standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants when the licensee is not independent, in fact and appearance, to the client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving a commission when also performing audit, review, compilation, or examination of prospective financial information for the same client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee may not, for a commission, recommend or refer to a client a product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer a product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee also performs for that client: (i) an audit or review of a financial statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing services for a contingent fee when also performing attest or compilation services, or preparing tax returns for a contingent fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee may not: (i) perform for a contingent fee a professional service for, or receive a contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: (A) an audit or review of a financial statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the title 'certified public accountant,' 'CPA,' or similar designation without a current license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using "certified public accountant," "public accountant," "CPA," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless that person: (a) has a current license as a certified public accountant issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing a report on financial statements without being licensed to practice public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: except as provided in Section 58-26a-305, engaging in the following conduct if not licensed under this chapter to practice public accountancy: (a) issuing a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit

definition_quote.value: "Practice of public accounting" means, while holding oneself out as a certified public accountant, offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accounting" means, while holding oneself out as a certified public accountant, offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client.

value: issuing reports or opinions on financial statements
methods_authorized.quote: offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client

value: audit or other engagement in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
review of a financial statement in accordance with SSARS
examination of prospective financial information in accordance with SSAE
examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement in accordance with SSAE
engagement in accordance with PCAOB standards
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest and attestation engagement" means providing any or all of the following financial statement services: (i) an audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (ii) a review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (iii) an examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (iv) an examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) ... (v) an engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presenting, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management or owners, without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: successful completion of a total of 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours of collegiate level education with a concentration in accounting, auditing, and business
education_semester_hours_required.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: demonstrate completion of at least 120 semester hours or 180 quarter hours of the education requirement described in Subsection 58-26a-302(1)(c)

ethics_exam_required.quote: "Qualifying examinations" means: (a) the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination; (b) the AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs; (c) the Utah Laws and Rules Examination

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: a person who qualifies under Subsection (1)(a) has all the privileges of a licensee of this state and may engage in acts included within the definition of the practice of public accountancy, whether in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means, based on a practice privilege in this state, and no notice, fee, or other submission shall be provided by that person.

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the division
comply with this chapter and the rules made under this chapter
cease offering or rendering professional services in this state if home-state license becomes invalid
appointment of the state board which issued the person's license as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: the person consents, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: (A) to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the division; (B) to comply with this chapter and the rules made under this chapter; (C) that in the event the license from the state of the person's principal place of business becomes invalid, the person shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state both individually and on behalf of the firm; and (D) to the appointment of the state board which issued the person's license as the person's agent upon whom process may be served

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: have, notwithstanding any other provision of law, a simple majority of the ownership of the Certified Public Accountant firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, held by individuals who are certified public accountants
firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A Certified Public Accountant firm may include owners who are not licensed under this chapter as outlined in Subsection (3)(a)(iii), provided that: (i) the firm designates a licensee of this state who is responsible for the proper registration of the Certified Public Accountant firm and identifies that individual to the division; and (ii) all nonlicensed owners are active individual participants in the CPA firm.
nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.citation: Section 302 - Qualifications for licensure and registration -- Licensure by endorsement.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: At the time of renewal a licensee shall show satisfactory evidence of each of the following renewal requirements: ... (b) successful completion of a peer review meeting the requirements established by rule by the division in collaboration with the board.
peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.citation: Section 303 - Term of license and registration -- Expiration -- Renewal.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in the practice of public accountancy

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a licensee under this chapter, incident to or in the course of professional service to a client, are the property of the licensee, in the absence of any express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.
working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.citation: Section 601 - Ownership of statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by licensee.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee may not, for a commission, recommend or refer to a client a product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer a product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee also performs for that client: (i) an audit or review of a financial statement; (ii) a compilation of a financial statement

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee may not: (i) perform for a contingent fee a professional service for, or receive a contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: (A) an audit or review of a financial statement; ... (ii) prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for a client.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: "Report" does not include a financial statement prepared by an unlicensed person if: (i) that financial statement has a cover page which includes essentially the following language: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying financial statements of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended. This presentation is limited to preparing, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management (owners). I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: A person currently licensed as a certified public accountant may, on any renewal date of that license, apply for and obtain a transfer of that license to a status of CPA emeritus registration
cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.citation: Section 307 - CPA emeritus status -- Renewal of license.

ethics_cpe_hours_required.quote: completing at least three hours of ethics education that cover one or more of the following areas

liability_privity_limitation.quote: A licensee, a CPA firm registered under this chapter, and any employee, partner, member, officer, or shareholder of a licensee or CPA firm are not liable to persons with whom they are not in privity of contract for civil damages resulting from acts, omissions, decisions, or other conduct in connection with professional services performed by that person

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a client, other than a report in which a lack of independence is disclosed, or performing an attest engagement subject to the attestation standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants when the licensee is not independent, in fact and appearance, to the client
